Water technology AEGIS NEXA Advanced water purification and recovery infrastructure. Envelope ≈1500×600×650 Cartridges Two Treatment Electrochemical Control JARVIS AEGIS NEXA is designed around efficient physical and electrochemical water treatment. It combines advanced filtration, electrochemical treatment, recovery, intelligent control and a cartridge-based architecture in an energy-conscious engineered system. Scroll to take it apart.
A compact engineered pod. The enclosure houses treatment, recovery, cartridges and control in one serviceable unit — designed as water infrastructure rather than an appliance. 02 / 08
Panels separate to reveal the internal architecture: pre-filtration, a pressure-lock / refill vessel, the treatment stack, two cartridges, the control module and the air system. 03 / 08
Source water enters through the inlet and is conditioned in the pre-filtration stage before reaching the pressure-lock / refill architecture. 04 / 08
Water moves through the advanced electrochemical / composite treatment stack — the stage where the AENXIC science meets engineered hardware. 05 / 08
A recovery pathway returns a stream for further treatment rather than discarding it. Recovery is approximately 90–94%. 06 / 08
Treated water passes through the cartridge stage to a dedicated outlet. Throughput is up to 48,000 litres per day. 07 / 08
Two cartridges lift out for service. The bundle concept includes two cartridges per year, keeping maintenance predictable. 08 / 08
The control module connects to every stage. JARVIS integration is intended to bring monitoring, control and engineering intelligence to the system. 01 System concept
The core concept is designed to avoid depending on a conventional high-pressure pump.
A sealed vessel stage that locks and refills in cycles, managing pressure within the system.
An air subsystem that replenishes the air volume the architecture relies on.
Two serviceable cartridges carry the treatment media; the bundle concept includes two per year.
Treatment built on electrochemical processes and composite materials — the AENXIC foundation. 02 Technical data

Water science AENXIC. The science beneath the system. Electrochemical processes, advanced materials and composite membrane architecture — aimed at heavy metals and microbial contamination. 01 Mechanism

h: Three things happen in the treatment zone
t: Ionic contaminants migrate An applied field moves heavy-metal and other ionic species toward active surfaces. Contaminants are retained Composite materials hold what has migrated, so it leaves with the cartridge rather than the water. Microbial cells are treated Electrochemical conditions in the same zone act on microorganisms as water passes through. 02 Intended contexts
Sources where heavy-metal contamination is the main concern. B
Shared infrastructure that needs low energy use and simple servicing. C
Places without reliable grid power or high-pressure pumping. 03 Terms

Recovery The share of feed water delivered as product water. Reject The share of feed water discarded instead of delivered. Removal efficiency How much of a given contaminant is removed. It depends on the contaminant and source water, so one figure never covers all cases. Specific energy Electrical energy used per litre of treated water, measured under stated operating conditions. → Contact Zaftrus

Engineering intelligence JARVIS. From intent to engineering execution. Not a chatbot. An engineering AI and control system that turns what an engineer means into what a system does. 01 Engineering Execution Graph

h: Eight stages from intent to action
t: Human intent Plain language, sketches or requirements. 02 Semantic understanding Objects, relationships, quantities, purpose. 03 Engineering reasoning Domain knowledge and trade-offs. 04 Constraints Loads, tolerances, materials, standards. 05 Parametric representation Editable parameters and relations. 06 CAD / geometry Parameters drive CAD operations. 07 Validation Checked against constraints. 08 Execution Files, operations, fabrication steps. 02 In practice

An engineer states a requirement. JARVIS parses it, applies domain reasoning, makes the constraints explicit, produces an editable parametric model, drives CAD to create geometry, and validates the result before anything is accepted. Every stage is inspectable, so a mistake can be corrected at the level where it was made.
Turns requests and documents into structured engineering objects. 02
Decides which engineering steps are needed and in what order. 03
Applies calculations, constraints, repair and provenance tracking. 04
Produces real geometry and exports engineering files. 04 Positioning

h: A chatbot versus an engineering system
t: A general chatbot Produces text from a prompt Constraints stay implicit Output is hard to verify Typically cloud-dependent JARVIS Produces parameters, geometry and files Constraints are explicit and checked Deterministic validation before acceptance Designed local-first AEGIS NEXA → Technology → → Contact Zaftrus
